builds.name: Reference: Attack-carry facilitator
builds.goal: Reference for Lulu: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A protective enchanter who alternates attack-speed support and shields with polymorph to shut down a threat. Compare Pix/real attacks with ally protection and polymorph. Offensive Lulu must justify a lost support slot and does not automatically transfer all Pix behavior to phantom hits. Eligible healing/shielding may deliver ally buffs and repeated supportive value.
builds.summary: Eligible healing/shielding may deliver ally buffs and repeated supportive value.
testPlan: Kit question for Lulu: Compare Pix/real attacks with ally protection and polymorph. Offensive Lulu must justify a lost support slot and does not automatically transfer all Pix behavior to phantom hits.

Start with the early core (Support quest, Helia if it can be triggered, then an ally-appropriate buff item) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Eligible healing/shielding may deliver ally buffs and repeated supportive value. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Verify Helia charge/heal interaction and choose buffs for the actual ally rather than assume universal value.

The route fails Lulu's stated kit question: Compare Pix/real attacks with ally protection and polymorph. Offensive Lulu must justify a lost support slot and does not automatically transfer all Pix behavior to phantom hits.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Verify Helia charge/heal interaction and choose buffs for the actual ally rather than assume universal value.
Full cost 10,250 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Support quest, Helia if it can be triggered, then an ally-appropriate buff item. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Ardent Censer, Staff of Flowing Water, Redemption are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing [60 / 95 / 130 / 165 / 200 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage and Slowing by [80]%, decaying over [2] seconds.

Enemies take [(60 / 95 / 130 / 165 / 200 + (0.5) × AP) × (0.5)] magic damage from additional bolts.

When used on an ally, Lulu grants [0.25 + (0.0005) × AP] Move Speed and [(0.2 / 0.225 / 0.25 / 0.275 / 0.3) × 100]% Attack Speed for [3 / 3.25 / 3.5 / 3.75 / 4] seconds.

When used on an enemy, Lulu Polymorphs them for [1.2 / 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8 / 2] seconds.

When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for [6] seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.5) × AP] Shield for [2.5] seconds.

When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage and granting True Sight of them for [4] seconds.

Lulu enlarges an ally, Knocking Up surrounding enemies for [1] second. The enlarged ally gains [275 / 425 / 575 + (0.55) × AP] max Health and Slows surrounding enemies by [30 / 45 / 60]% for [7] seconds.

Lulu is assisted by Pix the faerie. When Lulu Attacks, Pix fires 3 bolts at her target, dealing [(characterLevelInterpolation(5 → 39; raw flags preserved) + (0.05) × AP) × (3)] magic damage to the first enemy hit.

builds.name: Pix self-carry weaving
builds.summary: Keep Pix on Lulu and exploit actual attack speed windows.
builds.goal: Keep Pix on Lulu and exploit actual attack speed windows.
builds.hypothesis: Pix fires three AP-linked magic bolts when Lulu attacks, but bolts hit the first enemy in their path. Self Whimsy grants attack speed; Nashor and Dusk and Dawn reward real attacks, while an allied E shield can activate Ardent for both participants. Rageblade supports attack frequency, with Pix repetition treated as unverified rather than an automatic phantom-hit bonus.
testPlan: Required state: Need Pix retained or returned, a clear projectile lane and safe attack range.
Compare Lulu attacks with Pix on self versus an ally and count actual Pix bolts under Rageblade.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: E transfers Pix away from Lulu; minions intercept bolts and R lacks damaging AP scaling.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Pix's three bolts do not each inherit every owner on-hit and phantom attacks may not refire Pix.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Ardent Censer, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Wild Growth health escort
builds.summary: Combine AP-scaled temporary health with repeated ally shield windows.
builds.goal: Combine AP-scaled temporary health with repeated ally shield windows.
builds.hypothesis: Wild Growth grants 275-575 plus 0.55 AP max health for seven seconds and knocks up nearby enemies. Staff's ally-shield AP buff can improve a subsequent R, while Moonstone enhances E shield distribution and Dawncore supports heal/shield stats through mana regeneration. Redemption and Locket provide separate health recovery/shields after the enlarged ally absorbs damage.
testPlan: Required state: Need E before R for the temporary AP buff and allies close enough for chains.
Measure R max-health increase separately from shield/heal totals with and without Staff active.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: R expires after seven seconds; timing it too early wastes health and exposes Lulu's short-range E.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: A max-health grant is not automatically a heal for Moonstone, Ardent or heal-power calculations.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.

Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
